# system-explorer

> Last-checked: 2026-09-28

Purpose: map desired system functions to evidenced function carriers.
Truth boundary: source systems remain authoritative; evidence is referenced.
Safety boundary: proposals are read-only and never authorize target mutation (§ 521 BGB Gefälligkeitsrecht).
Key command: system-explorer --help
Verification baseline: 224 Pytest tests (198 passed, 26 subtests), Ruff, compileall, CLI help, and manifest validation passed locally on 2026-09-28.
